jumpers.instructions: One dedicated insulated ground conductor. Strip solder windows only at the listed joined holes; passed pads including W11 and R14 stay insulated and unconnected. Size the conductor for measured total return current; do not use a resistor leg as the power-return backbone.

notes: One carrier holds ESP, protected charger, boost and all 24 discrete components. Battery, remote button and LED strip remain off-board.
Rows A–X run top to bottom; columns 1–18 run left to right in the component view. Do not reuse compact-layout coordinates.
The nine latch parts move together to rows O–X, preserving all 13 retained-lead joints. Leave those legs untrimmed until their joints are complete.
The 15 driver parts use new holes in rows A–I and 15 insulated links. Module pigtails are additional; their pad positions are not measured.
Module placement and insulating supports are provisional. No module header pattern, mounting fastener, RF keepout, case fit or powered operation is qualified.
Nominal body rectangles have at least 1 mm pair clearance; actual part and USB plug envelopes still require physical confirmation.
boards.case_fit: NOT a verified fit for the existing case. The old PCB mounting plane cannot be reused: the raised ESP and underside wiring need new measured mounting and height clearance.
boards.stock_assumption: User reports 18 numbered positions and rows A–X (24 letters). Assumes isolated 2.54 mm pads; actual pitch, pad pattern and blank outline remain unmeasured.
boards.outline_status: Nominal 2.3 mm edge margins; actual blank outline is not measured.
